title: Pricing page review
turns: Hi Tom, thanks for making time. I wanted to go over the new pricing page before it goes live.
Sure. I looked at the draft this morning. The layout is clean, but the annual discount is hard to find.
Agreed. Where would you put it?
Right under the plan names, as a toggle between monthly and annual. Most competitors do it that way.
Okay, let's do the toggle. What about the enterprise tier? Sales wants a contact form instead of a price.
I think that's fine for enterprise. Keep the starter and team prices visible though.
Decision then: starter and team show prices, enterprise shows a contact form.
Yes. I can update the Figma file by Thursday.
Great. And I will ask legal to check the refund wording by Friday.
One more thing. The page still says fourteen day trial, but we moved to thirty days last month.
Good catch. Please fix that in the same pass.
decisions: Add a monthly/annual toggle under the plan names
Starter and team tiers show prices; enterprise shows a contact form

actions.text: Update the Figma file with the toggle and tier changes
Ask legal to check the refund wording
Change the trial length from 14 to 30 days on the page
